resolution.question: Will Harborview Credit Union provisionally credit Marisol's disputed 320-dollar card charge within the ten-business-day window she was quoted when she filed today?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Harborview Credit Union actually provisionally credited Marisol's account for the disputed 320-dollar charge on or before 2026-10-28T17:00:00-08:00 (the end of the ten-business-day window). Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
